text: OPD timings: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Sunday OPD is closed; emergency services are available 24x7.
Cardiology department is on the 2nd floor. Consultation fee is Rs 800. Appointments can be booked at the front desk or by phone.
Emergency ward is on the ground floor and open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Ambulance service is available.
